title: Flappy Bird
subtitle: Fly your character through the pipes.
tapToStart: Tap or press Space to flap
controls: Tap the screen, click, or press Space, W, or Up Arrow to flap.
rules: Each passed pipe awards 1 point. Don't hit pipes or the ground.
medals: Earn bronze (10+), silver (20+), or gold (30+) medals.
bestNote: Only runs scoring 1 or more are submitted to the leaderboard.
leaderboardNote: Your best score is automatically saved to the weekly, monthly, and all-time leaderboards.
